title: CAD-Simulators
intro: CAD and simulators for the DeepSc family (renamed from DeepSc-Tools, public). CAD tools are pinned git submodules of their upstream; sailytics is in-repo code (#1279 layout).

sections.title: Structure
sections.body:
```
CAD-Simulators/
  Structural-Designer/
    OpenCAD/      freecad-mcp, autocad-mcp (submodules)
    OpenRevit/    README, rvt-mcp (submodule, Revit MCP, Apache-2.0)
    OpenBIM/      README, bonsai-mcp (submodule, IFC/Bonsai MCP, MIT)
  Simulators/
    blender-mcp/  (submodule)
    sailytics/    (in-repo code)
  0_hub/DeepSc-___
```

sections.title: Sailytics
sections.body: `Simulators/sailytics`: in-repo code (not a submodule), moved with history from Projects-labtools `c-Stk_DsX/sailytics` (#1260). Own `build.json`/`build.sh`/`ship.yml`.
